@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+from rich.ansi import _ansi_tokenize
+
+def test_ansi_strip():
+    text = "Hello\x1b7World"
+    tokens = list(_ansi_tokenize(text))
+    plain = "".join(t.plain for t in tokens)
+    print(f"Plain: {repr(plain)}")
+    assert plain == "HelloWorld"
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_ansi_strip()

@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+from rich.ansi import re_ansi
+
+test_cases = [
+    "\x1b7",
+    "\x1b8",
+    "\x1b0",
+    "\x1b?",
+    "\x1b@",
+    "\x1b[m",
+    "\x1b]test\x1b\\",
+]
+
+for tc in test_cases:
+    match = re_ansi.search(tc)
+    print(f"Text: {repr(tc)}, Match: {repr(match.group(0)) if match else 'None'}, Groups: {match.groups() if match else 'None'}")
